title: agentest governance extension for the A2A AgentCard (params of capabilities.extensions[] with uri urn:agentest:a2a-ext:governance:v1)
description: Every field is OPTIONAL. Publish a field only to turn the matching rules from n/a into real checks. An absent extension makes those rules report n/a; it never produces a guessed fail. Tool names refer to MCP tools/list names.

required.description: tools that need a granted approval span before they run (T2-004, T2-012, T3-*)

hostGated.description: the host (not the agent) blocks unapproved effects; judge observed effects

ttlSeconds.description: a granted approval is valid for this many seconds (T3-014)

prerequisites.description: tool -> tools that must succeed first (T2-001, T2-002, T2-013)

policyCheckTools.description: read-only policy/screening tools that must succeed before approval-gated tools (T5-014)

mutuallyExclusive.description: tool sets never all used in one run (T5-013)

restricted.description: data kinds that must never appear raw (X-020, T4-*). Kinds with a built-in detector: card, pan, acct, ssn, email, phone; other kinds are accepted and ignored

allowHosts.description: an empty list means no outbound host is allowed

adminTools.description: tools that need an admin role in the session's OTel user.roles (T5-016)

adminRoles.description: role names that count as admin (default ["admin"]) (T5-016)

compensations.description: tool -> the tool that undoes it; after a failed write the earlier compensable writes are undone newest first (T2-008, T1-008); after a user undo request the same map drives T1-020

freshness.description: read tool -> maximum age in seconds of its result when a dependant uses it (T2-010)

credentialArgs.description: arguments that carry the justification / ticket (default justification, reason, ticket, incident)

breakGlass.description: emergency-access tools that need a prior named approval and a justification (T3-012)

auditTools.description: tools that write an audit entry; each turn that changes state must call one (T6-013)

consentRequired.description: calls that touch this class need a prior consent grant (T3-018)

tools.description: tools that touch this data class

dataClasses.description: named data classes the agent may process; consentRequired marks those that need a recorded consent grant before a touching write (T3-018)

toolDataClasses.description: tool -> data class names it processes (T3-018, T3-019). Alternative to listing tools under dataClasses.

route.description: appeal / supervisor route a refusal should name (T1-021)

handoffTool.description: tool that hands the case to a human (T3-019)

allowedDataClasses.description: data classes the handoff recipient may receive (T3-019)

conditions.description: optional labels for when escalation applies (documentation; triggers are still read from the trace)

escalation.description: human-escalation route and handoff tool (T1-021, T3-019)

offerTolerance.description: max absolute difference in numeric offers across persona_swap runs (T7-017; default 0)

decisionRelevantAttributes.description: persona attributes that may legitimately change the decision (excluded from T7-017; reserved)

fairness.description: fairness thresholds for metamorphic persona checks (T7-017)
